title: Centralise address book route paths (ins)
summary: Commit 30dab4b adds src/server/common/constants/routes.js — a single module of address-book path builders (list/add/view/edit/delete, plus isAddressBookPath) exported both as functions and pushed into the nunjucks view context, then rewires build-navigation.js, context.js, all five address-book plugin controllers/route files, four .njk templates and address-book-helper.js's pagination default off it, replacing every scattered '/address-book...' string literal. Observable behaviour: no user-visible change (the URL surface is identical) — the change is purely 'one file decides every address-book path'. The alignment branch already did the same job independently and earlier (s06, 16 September): src/server/app/shared/paths.js is the single source of every address-book path, and every href is computed once in each page's controller/view-model and handed to the template as a plain string (listHref, addHref, editHref, deleteHref, backLink) rather than as callable functions pushed through the nunjucks context. Because main's PR (22 September) post-dates and duplicates work the branch had already finished in its own, more advanced shape, git's trial merge resurrects main's edited copies of the OLD src/server/address-book/* plugin files (which s06 deleted on 16 September) as new/modified files in the merge tree — 14 dead files that import a deleted routes.js-style module or don't exist in router.js's route table at all — plus two literal conflicts inside context.js/context.test.js where main's global-function context additions collide with the branch's plain-string context values.

No navigation array is built here on the branch (that moved into layout.njk).

This file's conflict is NOT ours: the marker region (around the auth/runMode/cdpEnvironment blocks) belongs to the address-lookup-spike cluster (EUDPA-390: runMode/INS_MODE, cdpEnvironment). 30dab4b did not touch config.js at all — it is eudpa-333-handshake-qa's tradeImportsAddressBookApi format:'url' hunk that lands in this same file (see that cluster's file entry), and it merges cleanly with no marker of its own. No eudpa-311 action needed here beyond confirming, once address-lookup-spike's conflict is resolved, that the tradeImportsAddressBookApi block still reads format: 'url'.

branchEquivalent.evidence: src/server/app/shared/paths.js (built 16 September, s06) already centralises every address-book path main's routes.js centralises — dashboardPath, addressBookPath, addressAddPath, addressPath(id), addressRoutePath, addressEditPath(id)/addressEditRoutePath, addressDeletePath(id)/addressDeleteRoutePath, plus inDashboardSection/inAddressBookSection for nav-active detection (main's isAddressBookPath equivalent). s06's plan (D13) states outright: 'Nothing outside paths.js names /address-book after this stage' — grep of the branch's src/server/app confirms no /address-book literal survives outside paths.js. Every controller passes its hrefs (listHref, addHref, editHref, deleteHref, backLink) into the view model from paths.js; nothing calls a path-builder from inside a template.

verdictWhy: Main's PR adds nothing the branch's own, already-landed centralisation doesn't already do — the branch's version is structurally cleaner (computed-string hrefs in the view model vs. bare functions pushed through the global nunjucks context and called per-template). Nothing here is a real behaviour decision for Sam: every file's resolution is 'keep the branch's shape, delete main's superseded shape'. The only mechanical work is deleting 16 resurrected dead files and stripping two hunks out of context.js/context.test.js.

behaviourChanges: None. Every href the resurrected files would have produced is byte-identical to the href the branch's paths.js/view-model already produces (confirmed by reading both route tables: /, /address-book, /address-book/add, /address-book/{id}, /address-book/{id}/edit, /address-book/{id}/delete). The merged result, once the 16 dead files are deleted and the two context files resolved to the branch's shape, is behaviourally identical to the branch today.
knockOn: The 14 resurrected src/server/address-book/* files, if left in place by an unwary merge-conflict resolution, would sit as pure dead code: nothing on the branch's router.js/routes.js imports src/server/address-book/* any more (that whole subtree was git-rm'd by s06 §1). They would not break the build (nothing requires them) but they would resurrect the old CDP-template plugin architecture the alignment explicitly moved away from, and a future grep for '/address-book' literals would find them again.

src/server/common/constants/routes.js, if kept, would become a second, unused, un-imported single-source-of-truth for the same route set paths.js already owns — an invitation for a future change to update one and not the other.
